items.title: Illinois Offers ‘Fragmented’ Response To Gambling Addiction, Internal State Report Says
items.description: Study prepared for Pritzker finds gaming revenues ‘structurally dependent’ on vulnerable populations; problem gamblers “likely higher” than 1.1 million estimate.

items.title: Bucktown Park Renamed For Revered Chicago Artist Dont Fret
items.description: Park No. 567 attached to the 606 Trail has been renamed after the artist, who died last year. Signage will be updated in the next two weeks, the Park District said.

items.title: Morgan Park H.S. Community Still Reeling From Firing Of Football Coach
items.description: Despite a plea for "stability, honesty," Principal Dan Kuzma told parents and students at a local school council meeting Wednesday he can’t discuss the dismissal of longtime coach Chris James.

items.title: 26 Things To Do In Chicago This Weekend: Tree Lightings, Mag Mile Lights Festival And More
items.description: The opening of Zoo Lights, a printmaking festival, holiday markets, tailgate parties and more are also on deck.

items.title: Gunfire Leaves Man Dead At CTA Station, Woman Killed In Rogers Park, Man Shot In Lakeview
items.description: It's unclear if the incidents were related. The shootings began late Wednesday and into early Thursday morning, from Rogers Park to Lakeview.

items.title: This 12-Year-Old Violinist Will Make Symphony Center Debut As Youth Orchestra’s Youngest Member
items.description: Tentana Kahar will perform Sunday in the fall concert of the elite ensemble’s premier group.

items.title: Logan Theatre’s Iconic Sign Is Back Up — With New LED Letters
items.description: The sign swap, which happened quickly without consultation from area preservationists, has irked some neighbors and vintage sign advocates.

items.title: Marilyn’s Bar, Wine And Cocktail Spot From From Southport Betty’s Team, To Open In Lakeview
items.description: The wine and cocktail bar is coming to the former 404 Wine Bar with a creative beverage program, rotating wine list and French bistro-inspired small plates.
